'''2017 Worlds Day 2 Sam Olson LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Sam Olson]] at [[2017 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Sam Olson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 World Championship]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
